Looking at the Emmy nominations data I gathered, here are the years Modern Family received **at least 10 Emmy nominations**, ranked from most to least nominations:

| Year | Nominations | Key Categories |
|------|-------------|----------------|
| **2012** | 17 | Best Comedy Series (won), Supporting Actor & Actress, Sound Mixing (won), Plus Creative Arts |

| **2010** | 13 | Best Comedy Series (won), Multiple Supporting Actors (2 wins), Creative Arts |
| **2014** | 13 | Best Comedy Series (won), Supporting Actor (Burrell won), Multiple directing, Creative Arts |
| **2016** | 9 | Best Comedy Series (nominated), Supporting Actor, Creative Arts |

**Years with 10+ nominations:** 2012 (17), 2013 (16), 2011 (14), 2010 (13), and 2014 (13).
